categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the precision automation equipment sector, focusing on the research, production, sales, and technical support of solder paste printing equipment, dispensing equipment, packaging equipment, and flexible automation equipment. These products serve electronic assembly and semiconductor packaging industries, including SMT (Surface-Mount Technology), COB (Chip On Board), LED lighting and display, and semiconductor chip packaging.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as high-precision solder paste printing, dispensing with piezoelectric valves, and automated chip bonding (solid crystal) using Pick & Place and needle bonding techniques. It integrates software engineering, image processing, motion control, mechanical and electrical engineering, and CAE for product development. The manufacturing process includes standardized and customized production modes, with a focus on high precision, stability, and automation to meet evolving electronic assembly and semiconductor packaging demands.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading electronic assembly manufacturers in consumer electronics, automotive electronics, network communications, medical devices, aerospace, and smart home sectors. The company also serves LED lighting and display manufacturers and semiconductor packaging enterprises. Major clients include industry leaders such as Foxconn, Luxshare Precision, Huawei, BYD, and BOE, reflecting a broad and high-quality customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales, covering major industrial regions like the Pearl River Delta and Yangtze River Delta. It has expanded overseas markets through its Singapore-based subsidiary GKG ASIA PTE. LTD., with service points in Malaysia, Vietnam, India, Mexico, and other electronics manufacturing hubs, exporting products to over 50 countries and regions worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electronics manufacturing supply chain, providing specialized precision automation equipment essential for electronic assembly and semiconductor packaging processes. It supplies critical production machinery that directly impacts product quality and manufacturing efficiency in downstream electronics and semiconductor industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on advancing from SMT to broader semiconductor fields, emphasizing continuous innovation in solder paste printing, dispensing, packaging, and flexible automation equipment. R&D priorities include developing high-precision, high-stability equipment for Mini/Micro LED and semiconductor packaging, integrating AI and industrial automation technologies, and expanding product lines to cover emerging applications such as SIP and advanced semiconductor testing. The company invests heavily in R&D, maintaining over 9% of revenue in research expenditures and holding over 200 patents.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of precision automation equipment to manufacturing enterprises. The company employs a direct sales model complemented by a dealer network, focusing on customized solutions and after-sales technical support. Additional income sources include sales of core components like dispensing valves and investment income from financial products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading precision automation equipment provider with global competitiveness, especially in solder paste printing and dispensing technologies. It competes with international top-tier equipment manufacturers by leveraging advanced technology, high product quality, and comprehensive service. Its recognized status as a national champion and specialized 'little giant' enterprise underscores its strong industry standing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 856.6 million, a 15.75% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 70.5 million, up 34.12%. The company maintains a solid asset base exceeding RMB 2.3 billion with steady growth in net assets. Despite a negative net cash flow from operating activities due to increased payments, the company shows a positive growth trajectory supported by expanding sales and improved profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high precision, stability, and intelligent automation in its equipment, ensuring zero-defect solder paste printing and efficient dispensing critical for product quality and reliability. Its products support miniaturization trends in electronics and semiconductor packaging, offering customized flexible automation solutions that reduce customer costs and improve production efficiency. Strong R&D capabilities and comprehensive after-sales service provide customers with integrated solutions and sustained value.
